definitions.explanation: Describes something brilliantly beautiful, elaborate, and impressive. Often used for elegant, showy displays of beauty or skill.

examples.japanese: {華麗|かれい}な{技|わざ}で{観客|かんきゃく}を{魅了|みりょう}した。
examples.english: She captivated the audience with her brilliant technique.

examples.japanese: {宮殿|きゅうでん}の{華麗|かれい}な{装飾|そうしょく}に、{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}は{息|いき}を{呑|の}んだ。
examples.english: Visitors gasped at the palace's magnificent decorations.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {華麗|かれい}な{衣装|いしょう}.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {華麗|かれい}に (splendidly, magnificently)

NUANCE: {華麗|かれい} suggests dazzling, elaborate beauty - something that impresses with its brilliance and splendor. It can describe physical beauty, artistic performance, or elegant actions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {華麗|かれい}な{衣装|いしょう}/ドレス (gorgeous costume/dress)
- {華麗|かれい}な{技|わざ} (brilliant technique)
- {華麗|かれい}な{装飾|そうしょく} (magnificent decoration)
- {華麗|かれい}に{変身|へんしん}する (to transform splendidly)

RELATED WORDS:
- {豪華|ごうか} (luxurious, gorgeous)
- {絢爛|けんらん} (gorgeous, brilliant)
- {美|うつく}しい (beautiful - more common)
- {質素|しっそ} (simple, plain - opposite)
